tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Find bounded public catalogue variants. Indexed stock and prices are snapshots (converted from USD like the storefront shows them); call get_product_options for fresh prices and stock before create_cart_link. This never confirms activation eligibility.

countryCode.description: Explicit ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 activation country; do not infer it from language.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code such as USD, EUR, BRL or AUD. Prices come back in it, converted from the stored USD price at the verified storefront display rate (usdAmountMinor keeps the USD base); if no rate exists the price stays in USD and moneyCurrency says so. An unsupported code is refused with the list of supported codes.

language.description: Language for product names and links (default en).

tools.name: get_product_options
tools.description: Read fresh product variants, exact edition/platform/region, stock and explicit currency prices. Activation is advisory and unknown stays unknown; checkout revalidates prices and stock.

language.description: Language for product names and links (default en).

productSlug.description: Product or variant slug from a catalogue result.

tools.name: check_activation_country
tools.description: Check live advisory activation evidence for one exact variant and an explicit country. An incompatible variant remains purchasable under the storefront policy; unknown is never compatible.

tools.description: Return the existing verified official activation destination for an exact variant, without reading or embedding any purchased code. Detailed product instructions remain on the product page; ambiguous products return unknown.

tools.name: create_cart_link
tools.description: Create a lootcodes.com link that opens the buyer's cart review with exact variants and quantities (1 to 5 each, up to 10 items) chosen from get_product_options. The buyer sees each item, confirms, then pays on the site; this tool adds nothing to any cart, reserves no stock and creates no order. Items that are unavailable or need the product page (top-ups, custom amounts, several platforms) are returned in rejected.

productSlug.description: Product slug from a catalogue result.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code for the unit prices shown in the answer (default USD).

language.description: Language for names and links (default en).

tools.description: Read how LootCodes sells and delivers: what it sells, delivery, support contact and links to the terms, refund policy, privacy policy and FAQ.
